As senhas das pontes não são restauradas: Bridge passwords are not restored; please enter them again.
Cada ponte usa credenciais próprias; sen: Each bridge uses its own credentials; passwords stay in memory only and are never persisted. An empty known_hosts inherits the destination value.
Coleta de versões exige SSH; modo forçad: Version collection requires SSH; forced to None.
Conecte primeiro; Enter/ctrl+d detecta /: Connect first; Enter/ctrl+d detects /etc/os-release and uname. Host key checking is strict by default; the “Ignore” toggle equals StrictHostKeyChecking=no and is insecure.
Configurações não sensíveis; senhas nunc: Non-sensitive settings; passwords are never written.
Destino ainda não detectado ou configura: Destination not detected yet or configuration changed: Enter/ctrl+d runs detection.
Há repositórios de outra família de dest: There are repositories from another target family; remove them or adjust the target.
Modo apenas baixar: instalação e SSH est: Download-only mode: installation and SSH are disabled.
Nenhum repositório adicional; o download: No additional repositories; the download uses only official ones.
Nenhuma ponte configurada; a conexão vai: No bridge configured; the connection goes directly to the destination.
Presets validados: ubuntu 22.04/24.04, d: Validated presets: ubuntu 22.04/24.04, debian 12, centos 7 (prepared image) and alpine 3.20. The auto method uses compatible WSL on Windows and Docker otherwise.
Pré-check remoto automático; use Forçar: Automatic remote pre-check; use Force reinstall to ignore packages already present. Installation is never resumed automatically.
Retomando sessão #%d; reautentique e rev: Resuming session #%d; reauthenticate and review the data.
SSH: connection validated with host key.
Sem NOPASSWD • host key obrigatória • se: No NOPASSWD • host key required • secrets are never logged
Sessão #%d abortada: nenhum pacote foi i: Session #%d aborted: no package was installed. The report keeps the collected versions and the decision.
Syslog: RFC 5424 assíncrono (UDP/TCP); f: Syslog: asynchronous RFC 5424 (UDP/TCP); failures do not interrupt the pipeline.
Usado somente no ambiente isolado de dow: Used only in the isolated download environment; the list is additive and does not replace the official repositories. APK accepts a custom CA but not insecure TLS.
Usados somente no ambiente isolado de do: Used only in the isolated download environment; the list is additive.
